nodes.label: C
nodes.title:
The hypocrites who have already received rewards.
The outer correspondence is about rewards of heavenly Father. The inside correspondence is about hidden alms. The central part is about hypocrites. This structure indicates relationships between hidden alms and rewards of heavenly Father and also warning that hypocrites cannot recieve rewards of heavenly Father
